passages.title: Our JC Deepavali Exhibition
passages.text: For Deepavali, the Indian cultural society at my junior college held a small exhibition. We ⟦1|explain⟧ the meaning of the festival to our classmates and ⟦2|sharred⟧ traditional snacks. It was a good way to learn from one another.
passages.say: For Deepavali, the Indian cultural society at my junior college held a small exhibition. We explained the meaning of the festival to our classmates and shared traditional snacks. It was a good way to learn from one another.
